investigations.name: exponential-decay
investigations.description: The basic-functionality showcase for viva-amici. AMICI translates the Antimony decay model to C++, compiles a native extension, and CVODES integrates it. Over a 5-unit run (interval 1.0) the state A falls 10.0 -> 8.187 -> 6.703 -> 5.488 -> ... -> 3.6788, matching the closed-form 10*exp(-0.2*t) to ~7 digits.
investigations.title: Exponential decay (AMICI/CVODES, compiled)
investigations.objective: Driven as a process-bigraph process, does AMICI compile a single-species decay model and integrate it to the analytic exponential solution?

investigations.name: gg-01-differential-adhesion-sorting
investigations.title: Differential-adhesion cell sorting (Fig 12)
investigations.objective:
Under the Glazier & Graner (1993) Fig-12 sorting energies (J_ll=14, J_dd=2, J_ld=11,
J_lM=J_dM=16, T=10; gamma_ld=+3), does the wrapped Artistoo CPM sort a mixed two-type aggregate —
the cohesive dark type retreating to the interior, engulfed by a light monolayer — so that the
heterotypic boundary fraction falls while cells stay intact?
investigations.claim:
pbg-artistoo reproduces Fig-12 sorting: heterotypic fraction falls 0.479 -> 0.379 (-21%, mean of
3 seeds) with connectedness 0.998 — clean differential-adhesion engulfment, no motility.

investigations.name: gg-02-sign-and-temperature-controls
investigations.title: Sign and temperature controls (Fig 7 & Fig 9)
investigations.objective:
Are the two adversarial controls reproduced? (1) With NEGATIVE heterotypic tension (checkerboard,
Fig 7: gamma_ld=-3) the aggregate should intercalate and the heterotypic fraction should RISE —
the opposite of sorting. (2) At HIGH temperature (Fig 9: sorting energies at T=40) thermal
fluctuations should overwhelm the tension barriers and the aggregate should MIX rather than sort
cleanly. Do these behave as the paper predicts, and does the heterotypic-fraction order parameter
suffice to distinguish them from sorting?

investigations.name: repressilator-steady-state
investigations.description: The basic-functionality showcase for viva-copasi. build_composite("steady-state") wires CopasiSteadyStateStep to the bundled repressilator and asks COPASI's steady-state solver for the circuit's balance point. COPASI returns mRNA X=Y=Z=2.40822 and protein PX=PY=PZ=240.822, with a translation flux of 16.6925 and a transcription flux of 0.83463. The companion utc-process composite integrates the same model forward as an oscillator (a dynamics variant).
investigations.title: Repressilator steady state (COPASI/basico)
investigations.objective: Driven as a process-bigraph Step, does COPASI solve the steady state of the bundled Elowitz (2000) repressilator and return a structure-consistent fixed point?

investigations.name: vent-feasibility-gate
investigations.description: The basic-functionality showcase for viva-equilibrator. A fixed vent condition in a `world` store feeds EquilibratorThermoStep, which calls component-contribution to compute ΔG' for three reductive CO2-fixation reactions and a per-reaction feasibility flag. The composite is Step-only (no time-advancing process), so it emits one row. Observed: ΔG'(formate) = -48.66, ΔG'(acetate) = -150.74, ΔG'(pyruvate) = -88.28 kJ/mol; feasibility >= 0.9999 for all three.
investigations.title: Vent carbon-fixation feasibility gate (eQuilibrator ΔG')
investigations.objective: Driven as a process-bigraph Step, does eQuilibrator report H2-driven reductive CO2 fixation to formate, acetate and pyruvate as thermodynamically feasible at alkaline-hydrothermal-vent conditions?

investigations.name: hypoxia-motility
investigations.description: The showcase study for viva-grammar. The generic GrammarRulesProcess reads the verbatim hypoxia rules and drives the minimal reference substrate. Oxygen is depleted into a central hypoxic core; core cells transition to a motile phenotype (baseline speed 0.47 µm/min) and migrate up the oxygen gradient; the deepest core goes necrotic; late reoxygenation (uptake relief) reverts the motile cells.
investigations.title: Hypoxia → motility (grammar on a reference substrate)
investigations.objective: Does the generic grammar engine, driven by the paper's verbatim hypoxia rules, reproduce the transient post-hypoxic motile phenotype on a minimal reference ABM?

investigations.name: toggle-switch
investigations.description: The basic-functionality showcase for viva-maboss. A two-node MaBoSS network is advanced interval by interval by the cmaboss backend; each interval re-samples the joint state and emits each node's Boolean state and ensemble on-probability. Over a 30-interval run the last-10-interval mean on-probabilities are A = 0.529, B = 0.520 — both bounded in (0,1), the signature of the network's 4-state cycle.
investigations.title: Two-node Boolean network (MaBoSS / cmaboss)
investigations.objective: Driven as a process-bigraph process, does MaBoSS advance a two-node Boolean network and emit bounded, non-degenerate ensemble on-probabilities for both nodes?

investigations.name: tstmd-contraction-reorientation
investigations.description: REAL output of the TST-MD engine, driven CPU-only via the viva-tstmd Docker bridge (TST C++ + HOOMD + MUSCLE3). This study evaluates the paper-faithful coupling bar and FAILS it: across every parameter regime tried (fiber stiffness stiff->soft, crosslink density, contractility lambda up to 400, MD noise md_kT, adhesion-annihilation penalty, gradient vs uniform displacement selection) the cell contracts but its adhesions stay frozen in place — the cell detaches from the ECM rather than dragging it inward. This is the open cell-ECM coupling / calibration gap, reported as a failing reproduction, not hidden.
investigations.title: Cell–ECM mechanical coupling (real TST-MD, 2D) — NOT reproduced
investigations.objective: Does the real 2D static-adhesion hybrid CPM + bead-spring ECM engine (Tsingos et al. 2023, the published ancestor of Merks' 3D model) reproduce the paper's core mechanical-reciprocity result — a contractile cell that drags its focal adhesions and the attached, crosslinked ECM inward, reorienting and densifying the matrix?

investigations.name: tstmd-network-connectivity
investigations.description: REAL output of the TST-MD engine via the viva-tstmd Docker bridge. This study evaluates the paper-faithful percolation bar and FAILS it: at CPU-tractable sizes the giant component rises from 0.0007 (no crosslinks) but SATURATES at ~0.30 even at ~13000 created crosslinks — the network never percolates. The onset of connectivity is reproduced; full percolation (the regime the paper's mechanics depend on) is not.
investigations.title: ECM network percolation vs crosslinking (real TST-MD, 2D) — NOT reproduced
investigations.objective: Does the real 2D bead-spring ECM engine reproduce the paper's network percolation (Keijzer & Merks 2026, Fig 2B) — the giant component rising to a fully connected (~1.0) network at high crosslinking, the regime in which the matrix mechanically resists and transmits cell forces long-range?
